cloud.notes: No account or cloud connection is required for the documented local telemetry.

methods.notes: Use the SmartRow name/service combination where available. ComModule requires owner confirmation as an S4 Bluetooth ComModule because the standard FTMS service is not model-specific.

identification.notes: SmartRow advertisements carry its name and 0x1234 service. ComModule advertises standard FTMS 0x1826, which is shared with other fitness equipment and is not unique identification. Do not identify a rower from FTMS alone or assume the f364 extension is SmartRow.

device.name: WaterRower ComModule / SmartRow
device.notes:
Two related but distinct telemetry paths. ComModule attaches to an S4 Performance Monitor and exposes standard FTMS Rower Data. SmartRow is a separate power meter with service 0x1234, commands on 0x1235 and CR-delimited ASCII telemetry on 0x1236. Do not assign the ComModule f364 vendor extension to SmartRow; that extension remains undecoded.
SmartRow V3.10 records are 17 wire bytes: 16 visible characters plus CR. Reassemble fragments, validate sum(bytes 0-13) & 0xff against the two hex characters at 14-15, then decode by prefix. Distance digits at 1-5 use a low-nibble transformation. Force-curve units and the physical units of the b work/stroke-length fields are unresolved and remain raw.
The KEYLOCK exchange is an interoperability transform, not meaningful cryptographic authentication. No motor, workout-programming, resistance, calibration or firmware command is documented. LightRing BF is a separate LED device, not SmartRow telemetry; see protocol_details.lightring_bf.

openness.notes: FTMS is a published standard. SmartRow's command and record layouts are community-recovered, corroborated by the vendor app's protocol roles and a sanitized public V3.10 capture. Only derived facts are recorded.

upstream_docs.title: Bluetooth SIG Fitness Machine Service 1.0

pairing.notes: The reviewed SmartRow/ComModule paths do not establish a bonding requirement; other firmware or OS combinations remain unverified.

credentials.notes: The KEYLOCK transform is not an owner secret or secure provisioning credential.

factory_reset.effect: No common factory-reset procedure is established for ComModule and SmartRow. start_session is a workout reset/start, not a hardware factory reset.

methods.description: Confirm the S4 ComModule, subscribe to standard Rower Data, and aggregate fragmented records without writing the Fitness Machine Control Point.
methods.name: ComModule standard FTMS

steps.action: Confirm the device is the Bluetooth ComModule attached to the S4 monitor.
Subscribe to 00002ad1-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb and decode fields using payload_formats.FTMS_Rower_Data.
Retain partial-record fields until a notification with More Data bit 0 clear finalizes the record.

methods.description: Match SmartRow/0x1234, subscribe to 0x1236, perform only the required session exchange, then reassemble and validate ASCII records.
methods.name: SmartRow V3.10 telemetry

steps.action: Match SmartRow and service 00001234-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb, then subscribe to 00001236-0000-1000-8000-00805f9b34fb.
Use start_session only when beginning a new workout and any current session has been preserved. Do not probe unrelated hardware with it.
Reassemble 17-byte records, validate checksum and prefix, then decode the V3.10 fields. Keepalive is approximately every two seconds on V3.10, not a mandated interval.

setup.notes: No cloud account or application credential is needed for local telemetry. Pairing requirements beyond the observed open GATT paths are unverified.

rejoin.notes: Reconnect directly and resubscribe. No cloud session is required for local telemetry.

testing.notes: Not driven against hardware by this project. SmartRow V3.10 layouts come from a sanitized public capture: all 1,476 records pass the documented checksum, and all 44 bridge tests passed. ComModule uses standard FTMS. These establish source/capture consistency, not measurement accuracy or compatibility with other firmware. No physical WaterRower was used here.

variants.notes: Standard FTMS on the S4 Bluetooth ComModule. FTMS alone is not unique identification; owner confirmation is required.
Capture-backed ASCII record layouts are specific to V3.10. Other firmware needs validation before using these offsets/scales.

entities.name: ComModule Distance

entities.name: ComModule Stroke Rate
entities.notes: FTMS uint8 raw times 0.5 when More Data bit 0 is clear.

entities.name: ComModule Battery
entities.notes: When the standard Battery Service is exposed; values 101-255 reserved.

entities.name: SmartRow Distance
entities.notes: Five low-nibble-decoded decimal characters at offsets 1-5 after checksum validation.

entities.name: SmartRow Instant Power
entities.notes: c record offsets 6-8; zeroed for presentation after stop/timeout while raw state remains inspectable.

entities.name: SmartRow Average Power
entities.notes: c record offsets 9-13 divided by 10; retained across pauses.

entities.name: SmartRow Instant Pace
entities.notes: e record: minutes at 6 plus seconds at 7-8.

entities.name: SmartRow Average Pace
entities.notes: e record: minutes at 9 plus seconds at 10-11.

entities.name: SmartRow Elapsed Time
entities.notes: a record MMMSS: minutes at 6-8 plus seconds at 9-10; not hours/minutes/seconds.

entities.name: SmartRow Raw Force Point
entities.notes: x/y/z each provide eight (ord(char)-33)*16 points; concatenate for 24. No calibrated force unit is asserted.

FTMS_Rower_Data.description: Standard FTMS Rower Data on ComModule: uint16 LE flags, then present fields in the order below. Missing fields remain unavailable.

fields.description: uint8 when bit 0 is CLEAR; raw value times 0.5.
fields.name: stroke_rate

fields.description: uint16 LE when bit 0 is CLEAR.
fields.name: stroke_count

fields.description: uint8 when bit 1 is set; raw times 0.5.
fields.name: average_stroke_rate

fields.description: uint24 LE when bit 2 is set.
fields.name: total_distance

fields.description: uint16 LE when bit 3 is set; not speed in m/s.
fields.name: instantaneous_pace

fields.description: uint16 LE when bit 4 is set.
fields.name: average_pace

fields.description: Signed int16 LE when bit 5 is set.
fields.name: instantaneous_power

fields.description: Signed int16 LE when bit 6 is set.
fields.name: average_power

fields.description: uint8 when bit 7 is set; unitless, not automatically a damper number.
fields.name: resistance_level

fields.description: uint16 LE when bit 8 is set; 0xffff unavailable.
fields.name: total_energy

fields.description: uint16 LE when bit 8 is set; 0xffff unavailable.
fields.name: energy_per_hour

fields.description: uint8 when bit 8 is set; 0xff unavailable.
fields.name: energy_per_minute

fields.description: uint8 when bit 9 is set; workout telemetry, not validated for medical use.
fields.name: heart_rate

fields.description: uint8 when bit 10 is set; raw times 0.1.
fields.name: metabolic_equivalent

fields.description: uint16 LE when bit 11 is set.
fields.name: elapsed_time

fields.description: uint16 LE when bit 12 is set.
fields.name: remaining_time

parse_rules: Read flags little-endian. Bits 13-15 are reserved; bit 0 is inverted More Data, not a presence flag for more measurements.
When bit 0 is clear, Stroke Rate/Count are present and the record is final. When set, they are absent and more fragments follow. Retain partial fields until finalization.
Energy fields form one group under bit 8. Map their unavailable sentinels to unknown, not enormous readings.
A synthetic all-fields buffer uses flags 0x1ffe and is 29 bytes. It does not fit one default-MTU notification and is not a claim that real hardware sends every field together.

SmartRow_Record.description: One V3.10 ASCII record: 14 data characters, two uppercase hex checksum characters, then CR (17 wire bytes).

fields.description: Record family: a, b, c, d, e, f, x, y or z. Other prefixes are not decoded by this profile.
fields.name: prefix

fields.description: Five characters at 1-5. Decode each byte as (byte & 0x0f) | 0x30, then parse decimal metres.
fields.name: distance_digits

fields.description: Prefix-specific fields through offset 13; see protocol_details.smartrow_records.
fields.name: record_fields

fields.description: Two ASCII hex characters equal to sum(raw bytes 0-13) & 0xff.
fields.name: checksum

fields.description: CR 0x0d.
fields.name: terminator

parse_rules: Reassemble complete CR-terminated records before parsing. Require exactly 17 bytes for telemetry and reject short, trailing or unknown records.
Validate checksum before every field. Do not use the record if its checksum or prefix is invalid.
Decode distance independently of prefix. Ordinary ASCII digits pass through unchanged, so the low-nibble rule is also harmless on older records.
Power average, work and stroke-rate decimal scaling is division by 10; preserve raw precision. The bridge rounds only for presentation.
An f record with ! at offset 11 means stopped. Repeated c/d/e values after it are stale until a new stroke, not new activity.

keylock.challenge: Sixteen visible ASCII characters beginning KEYLOCK=, with big-endian seed hex at offsets 10-13 and two checksum characters at 14-15, optionally CR/LF wrapped; validate checksum before responding
keylock.response_algorithm: seed = big-endian hex value; value = seed * 17923 // 256; format as six uppercase hex digits, drop first two, return remaining four lowercase wrapped in CR
keylock.security: Interoperability transform, not evidence of meaningful cryptographic authentication

lightring_bf.experimental: 05/0d native animation timelines exist in the public implementation but are not confirmed on hardware and are not declared as supported commands here
lightring_bf.identity: Separate LightRing BF LED device, not SmartRow telemetry or ComModule configuration
lightring_bf.pairing: No pairing/bonding required in the public implementation
lightring_bf.pixel_frame: 02 slot_le16 followed by exactly 52 green/red/blue triplets (159 bytes total); unused pixels zero
lightring_bf.select_frame: 03 slot mode_flag duration_le16; integration uses slot 0, mode 0, duration 0. Exact loop/start semantics unresolved
lightring_bf.solid_color: 00 green red blue (four bytes); red is 00 00 ff 00

a.elapsed: minutes at 6-8, seconds at 9-10 (MMMSS), not hours/minutes/seconds

b.stroke_length: characters 11-13; bridge calls centimetres, preserve raw pending physical calibration
b.work_per_stroke: characters 6-10 divided by 10; physical unit unresolved

common.checksum_encoding: two ASCII hex characters at 14-15 = sum(raw[0:14]) & 0xff

e.average_split: minutes at 9 plus seconds at 10-11, unit s/500m
e.instant_split: minutes at 6 plus seconds at 7-8, unit s/500m

f.stopped: exclamation mark at offset 11; repeated c/d/e values are stale until a new stroke

force_curve.concatenation: x, then y, then z = 24 points
force_curve.units: unresolved; preserve the raw force profile, do not infer calibrated force

remaining_unknowns: SmartRow layouts are V3.10-specific; other firmware must be captured before using these offsets/scales.
Force-curve units and the physical units of b work and stroke length remain unresolved.
The ComModule f3641401/f3641404 extension is undecoded and is not SmartRow.
No physical WaterRower, ComModule, SmartRow or LightRing was used by this project.
LightRing native animations and exact select-frame loop/start semantics remain experimental.

format.name: flags
format.notes: Bits 1-12 determine optional fields; bit 0 is inverted More Data; bits 13-15 reserved.

characteristics.name: Rower Data
characteristics.notes: Standard FTMS little-endian flags followed by present fields in payload_formats.FTMS_Rower_Data order. Bit 0 is inverted More Data: clear means Stroke Rate/Count are present and the record is final; set means those fields are absent and more fragments follow.

characteristics.name: Battery Level
characteristics.notes: Standard uint8 percentage 0-100; other values reserved. Presence on every ComModule needs hardware verification.

keepalive.description: Keepalive poll; approximately every two seconds on V3.10, not a hardware-mandated interval.

request_configuration.description: Request configuration after a V3 greeting.

request_keylock_challenge.description: Request a key-lock challenge after a V3 version reply. This is an interoperability exchange, not meaningful authentication.

request_remote_text.description: Request remote/configuration text, CR REMOTE> CR.

start_session.advanced_reason: Starts/resets the active workout session. Preserve any session that must be kept before sending it; this is not a factory reset.
start_session.description: Initial start/reset sequence; the pulley answers with its version. Only send when starting a new workout.

characteristics.name: SmartRow commands
characteristics.notes: ASCII session/configuration commands. Do not use these as generation-discovery probes; match SmartRow and 0x1234 first.

characteristics.name: SmartRow telemetry
characteristics.notes: CR-delimited ASCII. Reassemble fragments before decoding; one notification is not necessarily one record. Telemetry records are 17 bytes including CR. Validate checksum before interpreting any field, including KEYLOCK challenges.
